properties.name: crm.user.cleanup-interval
properties.description: Time between two runs of the task that deletes the users without an open socket, as an ISO-8601 duration, default = "PT15M"

properties.name: crm.communication.socket-io.origin
properties.description: Origin allowed to open Socket.IO connections, default = "*". Browsers refuse cookies with "*", so set the explicit origin when the client connects from another origin
